It's giant. It's scaraby. What else does anyone need to know? If one looks closely enough they'll spy Kaleef's Keris dagger - a weapon crafted to destroy any one who should worship Scabaras.

Quest: Contact!

Combat: The scarab is a mighty foe by himself, but he'll also summon locust riders, mages and rangers to fight by his side. The giant scarab himself attacks with a mixture of melee and ranged while his helpers will set upon you with a mixture of all corners of the combat triangle. The giant scarab will also poison you if you're fighting from a distance.
